title: Counting bits
statement: Return an array where entry i is the number of 1 bits in i, for 0 ≤ i ≤ n, in O(n).
hints: i and i >> 1 differ only in the last bit.

solution.explanation: bits(i) = bits(i >> 1) + (i & 1), or bits(i) = bits(i & (i − 1)) + 1, since i & (i − 1) clears the lowest set bit. Both are one-line DPs whose recurrence comes from the binary representation.
solution.cpp: vector<int> countBits(int n) { vector<int> o(n + 1, 0); for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) o[i] = o[i >> 1] + (i & 1); return o; }
